text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

During lunch break one day. Oguri Cap was 
clutching her bento box, letting out a 
quiet sigh.

Normally at this time, the famously big 
eater would be filling her stomach to her 
heart's content in the cafeteria, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ugh... It's no good, my stomach is just...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But... I can't go to the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ... The truth is...—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Yesterday, I was eating a ton of food 
like I always do. And then...

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...Must be nice, Oguri-senpai. Eating 
that much and not gaining any weight. I 
guess it's just... constitution."

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Meanwhile, I gain weight just by running 
or breathing. If only I could eat without 
caring about anything, too... ...Hah, it's 
so tough."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—It shocked me. Not everyone is able to 
eat whatever they want, freely, and as 
much as they'd like...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Seeing me eat so much was actually causing 
someone pain.
choice_data_list:
So that's why you're eating in a secluded 
spot?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But... as expected, a single bento 
just... isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to eat so much more, but...
choice_data_list: You should eat without worrying about it.

I think there's a good reason you eat so 
much.

I believe there's a reason why you eat so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to eat so much more, but...
choice_data_list: You should eat without worrying about it.

I think there's a good reason you eat so 
much.

I believe there's a reason why you eat so 
much.

text_block_list.text:
There are many other big eaters at this 
academy besides Oguri Cap. Even if she 
tries to be considerate, it won't change 
that girl's struggle.
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's something she has to come to 
terms with on her own.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...That might be true. Even so... it still 
makes me sad.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Eating is supposed to be joyful and 
delightful. So seeing someone endure only 
pain through it... is heartbreaking.

I understand Oguri Cap's kindness. But 
hiding away changes nothing... If that's 
the case, then perhaps—
choice_data_list:
Then let's thoroughly enjoy our meals 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Eh... But...
choice_data_list: It will definitely be all right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I'll try doing what you 
said.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Oguri-senpai is eating even more 
than usual today. Still, though...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
...She really looks so happy. Somehow... 
it makes me want to eat more too!

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~ So jealous, so jealous, so jealous... 
Fried rice, ramen, karaage... No, no, 
carbs, fats, carbs and fats...!

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh~ Enduring this forever is totally 
impossible after all! Carbs and fats are 
just too delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! That girl...

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should consult a nutritionist... 
Yeah, that's it! I'll have them brainstorm 
a plan with me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now then, back to my meal. ...Itadakimasu!

Oguri Cap eats a lot... no, an astounding 
amount. However, she undeniably burns just 
as much through intense activity.

That holds true for other horse girls as 
well. But... gauging by the volume Oguri 
Cap consumes, her workout workload must be 
on an otherworldly level.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's how it is.
choice_data_list: Hm? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In short... I just need to let everyone 
know that I move just as much as I eat.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In that case—she can just train together 
with me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—After our break, we're doing 10 sets of 
100 abdominal crunches.

That afternoon, I spotted Oguri Cap 
training alongside a horse girl who 
appeared to be her junior.

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Th-This is... so rough... 
ngh.

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, Oguri-senpai... Do you always train 
under this much intensity...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... since you're with me today, I 
reduced the number of sets. Normally... 
it's about double this?

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek... Well, no wonder you eat that 
much...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Won't you eat a whole bunch today too?

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Food tastes exceptionally delicious after 
finishing a workout like this. That much 
is certain.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Eating whatever you love after moving your 
body to the limit— having days like that 
is perfectly fine...!

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...If I can keep up with this training, 
then taking in calories... shouldn't be a 
problem, right?

text_block_list.name: Dieting Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, Oguri-senpai! Please crank up the 
intensity! Because after this... I want to 
eat extra-chashu ramen!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yeah!
